candidates: Epidermoid cyst in the cerebellopontine angle
key_facts: Left facial asymmetry observed during crying
MRI showed an enhancing mass in the left cerebellopontine angle and internal auditory canal
Follow-up MRI showed considerable growth of the mass
ABR testing demonstrated profound hearing loss in the left ear
Histopathological examination revealed a vascular lesion with low levels of mitotic activity
Biphasic lesion composed of vascular nodules among spindle cells
Glomeruloid-like architecture of vascular epithelial nodules

raw.rationale: The histopathological examination revealing a vascular lesion with low levels of mitotic activity, biphasic lesion composed of vascular nodules among spindle cells, and glomeruloid-like architecture of vascular epithelial nodules is consistent with Kaposiform hemangioendothelioma.

rejected.label: Epithelioid Hemangioendothelioma
rejected.why: While it is a vascular tumor, the specific histopathological features described do not exactly match those typically seen in Epithelioid Hemangioendothelioma.

rejected.label: Congenital Hemangioblastoma
rejected.why: Hemangioblastomas are typically associated with von Hippel-Lindau disease and have a distinct histological appearance that includes cystic spaces and rich vascularity, not described in this case.

rejected.label: Vestibular schwannoma
rejected.why: This tumor type is more common in adults and does not typically present with the rapid growth or specific histopathological features described in this case.

rejected.label: Epidermoid cyst in the cerebellopontine angle
rejected.why: Epidermoid cysts have a distinct appearance on imaging and histologically, which does not match the vascular lesion described in this patient.
